# Compatibility matrix

<!-- Generated by `go run ./scripts/gen-compat-matrix`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Spec section 19.9. Protocols are the wire codecs under `internal/wire`; clients are the built-in launcher profiles in `internal/launcher`.

## Protocols

| Protocol | Endpoint | Features |
|---|---|---|
| anthropic | POST /v1/messages | request codec, compress args, stream passthrough, tool injection, usage |
| openai | POST /v1/chat/completions | request codec, compress args, stream passthrough, tool injection, usage |
| responses | POST /v1/responses | request codec, compress args, stream passthrough, tool injection, usage |
| google | POST models/*:generateContent, :streamGenerateContent | request codec, compress args, stream passthrough, tool injection, usage |

## Clients

| Client | Command | Upstream | Protocols | Mode | Base URL variable | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| claude | claude | https://api.anthropic.com | anthropic | base URL (spec 19.9, degree 3) | `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` | supported |
| codex | codex | https://api.openai.com/v1 | openai, responses | base URL (spec 19.9, degree 3) | `OPENAI_BASE_URL` | supported |
| gemini | gemini | https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com | google | base URL (spec 19.9, degree 3) | `GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL` | supported |
| opencode | opencode |  | none | MITM (spec 19.9, degree 5) | - | not launched: no base URL variable |

## Status legend

- **supported**: the launcher sets the base URL variable and the protocols above handle the requests.
- **not launched**: the client has no base URL variable, so the base URL launcher refuses it (`launcher.ErrNoBaseURL`).
